block/minecraft:custom_components: typed `never` on purpose: custom components of 1.21.90+ are namespaced component keys, `customComponents` is only the pre-1.21.90 string list
block/minecraft:instrument_sound: schema variant noise: `up`/`down` must match `^note.`, the generator cannot produce it
block/minecraft:redstone_producer: `strongly_powered_face` is one face (official schema `Facing`, game 1.26.50+ rejects a list); the Blockception schema variant is a list, which the SDK type deliberately refuses (runtime unwraps a one-element list with a warning)
block/minecraft:tags: SDK sugar: `tags: [...]` is written as `minecraft:tags: [...]` from format 1.26.20 and as legacy `tag:<name>` keys before; the SDK takes a list, not the component object
entity/minecraft:angry: vanilla uses legacy camelCase keys (`broadcastAnger`, `broadcastRange`) that Minecraft accepts next to the snake_case schema names; the SDK writes the schema names
entity/minecraft:area_attack: vanilla enum_property filter uses a non-string `domain` in a nested filter
entity/minecraft:breathable: vanilla legacy camelCase keys (`totalSupply`, `suffocateTime`), see angry
entity/minecraft:damage_sensor: vanilla `cause` values missing from the schema enum and legacy `other_with_families` filter
entity/minecraft:environment_sensor: vanilla filters that omit a `value` the schema marks as required
entity/minecraft:looked_at: vanilla `looked_at_event.filter` (legacy key of the event object)
item/minecraft:icon: SDK sugar: `icon: 'key'` is written as `{ textures: { default: 'key' } }`
item/minecraft:tags: SDK sugar: `tags: [...]` is written as `{ tags: [...] }`; schema variant noise for tag enums
